general_information.Description: This course of study is for students of advanced level learners who need to be able to understand and use the English in the academic context. The units are organized thematically linked sections and cover a wide range of subjects while introducing various test taking skills.
general_information.StudentTasks: Regularly attend class-meeting hours and complete assignments and homeworks For BBA students: must attend at least 80% of the total course time in order to be admitted to the final exam

description: This course of study is for students of advanced level learners who need to be able to understand and use the English in the academic context. The units are organized thematically linked sections and cover a wide range of subjects while introducing various test taking skills.

assessments.Question Type: 1. A report to describe and summarize information using data given in graphs/ diagram / tables; 2. An essay to present opinions, arguments, solutions
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Students write to complete two essays using the techniques learnt in the respective units. Focus of each test is described in the detailed contents in Appendix 1
assessments.Grading Guide: In classroom, supervised by class instructor/s
assessments.Note: The tests must be designed based on the skills covered in the tested units.

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Students write to complete two essays using the techniques learnt in 10 units
assessments.Note: Do not allow to use any document/information in any form in exam room
